facts.fact: The Libyan News Agency reports that the Tripoli Security Directorate inaugurated its digital transformation system on 31 December 2025, among whose components is a system for the evidence-gathering (investigation) reports of police stations and traffic sections; the report does not say whether the first complaint is also entered.
facts.system: منظومة محاضر جمع الإستدلالات بمراكز الشرطة وأقسام المرور

facts.fact: The Libyan News Agency reports that the Tripoli Security Directorate itself launched the system at its headquarters on 31 December 2025, with the Attorney General, the security director and a representative of the acting Minister of Interior present; no partner, vendor or source of finance is named.
facts.system: منظومة محاضر جمع الإستدلالات بمراكز الشرطة وأقسام المرور

facts.fact: The Tripoli Security Directorate inaugurated its digital transformation system, including the police-station investigation-reports system, on 31 December 2025, according to the Libyan News Agency.

facts.fact: The Libyan News Agency's report of the 31 December 2025 launch names the system as one for police stations and traffic sections of the Tripoli Security Directorate and gives no count of stations using it, no total and no station outside Tripoli.
